business_problem: Circuitry.ai needed to speed retrieval over large proprietary product datasets because manual information lookup and constant content updates were delaying the rollout of RAG assistants for manufacturers.
solution_summary: Circuitry.ai uses Databricks Data + AI Platform, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and MLflow to support RAG search for manufacturing decision intelligence. Circuitry.ai needed to speed retrieval over large proprietary product datasets because manual information lookup and constant content updates were delaying the rollout of RAG assistants for manufacturers. In practice, the implementation stores or organizes core datasets in Delta Lake, governs access and lineage with Unity Catalog, and runs transformation or AI logic on Databricks Data + AI Platform. Documents, notes, and knowledge assets are consolidated into Delta Lake; Databricks Data + AI Platform applies analytics or model logic. The case study reports Building smarter decision intelligence for manufacturers 60–70% and 60–70%, showing measurable improvement after the rollout.
business_outcome: Circuitry.ai reported Building smarter decision intelligence for manufacturers 60–70% and 60–70%, improving RAG search for manufacturing decision intelligence with measurable gains in productivity improvement, customer experience, and speed to market.
